description: Run a free Verifux snapshot on a URL: a fast, deterministic read of UX, conversion and AI-agent readiness. Returns a band (Strong/Mixed/Weak/Poor), a pass rate over a named set of automated checks, the top findings, and whether the page declares an AI-agent surface. No score out of 100 (that is the full paid audit). No sign-up or API key required.

url.description: The page URL to audit (any publicly reachable URL).

name: run_snapshot
